same_blocking_condition: No uniquely specified physically normalized full-TGL lens observable with a nonzero residual after allowed nuisance fits, nor an independently calibrated mass anchor for the proportional branch.

resumed_turns.remaining_blocker: Conditional scalar source derived; its physical parameters/complete-action map remain open.
Existing covariant proportional source gives zero identifiable residual; external calibration not established.
Unchanged source contract and public observable checks do not fix the missing transfer or independent mass calibration.

safe_actions_exhausted_for_current_contr: Reused and checked historical amplitudes/profiles; conditional source response; existing covariant sector; mass/distance profiling; focused public data/calibration check.
Another arbitrary scalar parameter choice or generic forecast would not make the requested fullTGL prediction determined.
unblock_conditions: A concrete full-action representation/source or additional physical relation fixes the non-proportional lens response without fitting target delays.
A documented independent mass calibration with its uncertainty and theory dependence is available to test the existing proportional branch.
scope_limit: Not a proof that no future construction or dataset can resolve the problem; current mission lacks the required physical input.
